exercises.instructionEn: Graduation Day - a composition about a celebration (4 paragraphs).
exercises.instructionUz: Bitiruv kuni - bayram haqida insho (4 xatboshi).
exercises.explanationUz:
BAYRAM HAQIDA INShO - BITIRUV
  (coursebook 97-bet yozish
  rejasi).

TUZILISh:
  Para 1 - nima? qayerda? qachon?
  Para 2 - marosimdan OLDIN
  Para 3 - marosim DAVOMIDA
  Para 4 - yozuvchining HIS-
    TUYG'ULARI

  ⚠ Har xatboshi MAVZU GAPI (topic
  sentence) bilan boshlanadi -
  14a da shu gaplar qo'yiladi.


⚠ 'GRADUATION':

  = bitiruv (universitet).
  'to graduate' = bitirmoq.


⚠ 'CAPS AND GOWNS':

  = bitiruv qalpog'i va mantiyasi.


⚠ 'THE CHAIRMAN':

  = rais (rektor).


⚠ 'DEGREE CERTIFICATES':

  = diplomlar.


⚠ 'TO CHEER':

  = qarsak chalib olqishlamoq.


⚠ PAST PERFECT MATNDA:

  'had all been looking forward
  to', 'Once all the students had
  sat down'.

points.en: [c] Last September I graduated from university. It was a day that my friends and I had all been looking forward to for ages, and we were proud to be there after three years of hard work.
points.uz: [c] O'tgan sentyabrda men universitetni bitirdim. Bu men va do'stlarim uzoq vaqtdan beri intiqlik bilan kutgan kun edi va uch yillik mashaqqatli mehnatdan keyin u yerda bo'lganimizdan faxrlanardik.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 1 - what? where? when? Mavzu gapi: c.

points.en: [d] On the morning of the graduation ceremony, I arrived early and met my friends outside the main building. We went to a large room where they gave us our black caps and gowns. After that, we wrote our names in the graduation book and went off to get ready for the ceremony.
points.uz: [d] Bitiruv marosimi tongida men erta kelib, do'stlarimni asosiy bino oldida uchratdim. Biz katta xonaga bordik, u yerda bizga qora qalpoq va mantiyalarimizni berishdi. Shundan keyin bitiruv kitobiga ismlarimizni yozdik va marosimga tayyorlanishga ketdik.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 2 - before the ceremony. Mavzu gapi: d.

points.en: [a] Two hours later, we were sitting in the huge graduation hall, waiting for the ceremony to begin. We smiled at our parents who were sitting on the balcony watching. Once all the students had sat down, the university officials came into the hall. The chairman of the university gave a speech, then he started calling out names. One after the other we walked up to the stage and collected our degree certificates. Then everyone cheered as we went back to our seats. Finally, there were some more speeches before we all went outside into the university gardens to take photographs of each other.
points.uz: [a] Ikki soatdan keyin biz ulkan bitiruv zalida marosim boshlanishini kutib o'tirgan edik. Balkonda o'tirib tomosha qilayotgan ota-onalarimizga jilmaydik. Barcha talabalar o'tirgach, universitet rahbarlari zalga kirishdi. Universitet raisi nutq so'zladi, keyin ismlarni o'qiy boshladi. Birin-ketin sahnaga chiqib diplomlarimizni oldik. Keyin joylarimizga qaytganimizda hamma olqishladi. Nihoyat, yana bir nechta nutqlardan keyin hammamiz bir-birimizni suratga olish uchun universitet bog'iga chiqdik.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 3 - during the ceremony. Mavzu gapi: a.

points.en: [b] We were all extremely proud, happy and excited to have graduated, but we were sad too. Graduation meant that we weren't students any more. It was the end of our university days, but it was also the beginning of something new.
points.uz: [b] Hammamiz bitirganimizdan juda faxrlanar, xursand va hayajonda edik, lekin g'amgin ham edik. Bitiruv endi talaba emasligimizni anglatardi. Bu universitet kunlarimizning oxiri edi, lekin ayni paytda yangi narsaning boshlanishi ham edi.
points.noteUz: ⚠ PARA 4 - writer's feelings. Mavzu gapi: b.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the missing topic sentences from the list: a) Two hours later, we were sitting in the huge graduation hall, waiting for the ceremony to begin. b) We were all extremely proud, happy and excited to have graduated, but we were sad too. c) Last September I graduated from university. d) On the morning of the graduation ceremony, I arrived early and met my friends outside the main building.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdan tushib qolgan mavzu gaplarini qo'ying: a) Ikki soatdan keyin biz ulkan bitiruv zalida marosim boshlanishini kutib o'tirgan edik. b) Hammamiz bitirganimizdan juda faxrlanar, xursand va hayajonda edik, lekin g'amgin ham edik. c) O'tgan sentyabrda men universitetni bitirdim. d) Bitiruv marosimi tongida men erta kelib, do'stlarimni asosiy bino oldida uchratdim.
exercises.explanationUz:
MAVZU GAPLARI (topic sentences):

  1 → c (qachon, nima - 'Last
    September I graduated')
  2 → d ('On the morning ... I
    arrived early' → keyin 'We went
    to a large room')
  3 → a ('Two hours later ... in the
    hall' → keyin 'We smiled at our
    parents')
  4 → b ('proud, happy ... sad too'
    → keyin 'Graduation meant')


⚠ 'A TOPIC SENTENCE':

  = mavzu gapi - xatboshining
  birinchi, asosiy g'oyasini
  beruvchi gapi.

d) On the morning of the graduation ceremony, I arrived early and met my friends outside the main building.

pairs.right: a) Two hours later, we were sitting in the huge graduation hall, waiting for the ceremony to begin.
pairs.rightUz: a) Ikki soatdan keyin zalda marosimni kutib o'tirgan edik.
pairs.whyUz: ⚠ Marosim davomida - 'We smiled at our parents'.

pairs.right: b) We were all extremely proud, happy and excited to have graduated, but we were sad too.
pairs.rightUz: b) Hammamiz faxrlanar, xursand edik, lekin g'amgin ham.

SAVOLLAR - O'TGAN ZAMON (bayram
  haqida).

  1 Did you have a good weekend?
  2 When and where was it?

structure.modelEn: Last Saturday night, my parents celebrated their 25th wedding anniversary with a huge party at our summer house by the lake. It was a day that our whole family had been looking forward to for months, and over two hundred people came.
structure.modelUz: O'tgan shanba kechasi ota-onam 25 yillik nikoh yubileyini ko'l bo'yidagi yozgi uyimizda katta bazm bilan nishonlashdi. Bu butun oilamiz oylar davomida intiqlik bilan kutgan kun edi va ikki yuzdan ortiq odam keldi.

structure.modelEn: The preparations took several days. My sisters and I had to make the food, clean the house and put up the decorations. I also had to book a jazz band for the evening.
structure.modelUz: Tayyorgarlik bir necha kun oldi. Opalarim va men ovqat tayyorlashimiz, uyni tozalashimiz va bezaklarni osishimiz kerak edi. Kechqurun uchun jaz guruhini ham band qilishim kerak edi.

structure.modelEn: On the night of the party, everything was perfect. The guests admired the decorations and enjoyed the delicious buffet. When the jazz band started playing, everyone got up to dance. We sang and danced to the music all night long.
structure.modelUz: Bazm kechasi hammasi mukammal edi. Mehmonlar bezaklarni tomosha qilib, mazali bufetdan bahra olishdi. Jaz guruhi chala boshlaganda hamma raqsga turdi. Tun bo'yi musiqaga qo'shiq aytib, raqs tushdik.

structure.modelEn: It was a fantastic celebration and my parents certainly enjoyed themselves. I was tired but very happy. I'm sure it will be a great memory for all of us.
structure.modelUz: Bu ajoyib bayram bo'ldi va ota-onam albatta ko'ngil ochishdi. Men charchagan, lekin juda xursand edim. Bu hammamiz uchun ajoyib xotira bo'lishiga ishonaman.

modelAnswers:
A Silver Wedding Anniversary

Last Saturday night, my parents celebrated their 25th wedding anniversary with a huge party at our summer house by the lake. It was a day that our whole family had been looking forward to for months, and over two hundred people came.

The preparations took several days. My sisters and I had to make the food, clean the house and put up the decorations. I also had to book a jazz band for the evening.

On the night of the party, everything was perfect. The guests admired the decorations and enjoyed the delicious buffet. When the jazz band started playing, everyone got up to dance. We sang and danced to the music all night long.

It was a fantastic celebration and my parents certainly enjoyed themselves. I was tired but very happy. I'm sure it will be a great memory for all of us.
modelAnswersUz:
Kumush to'y

O'tgan shanba kechasi ota-onam 25 yillik nikoh yubileyini ko'l bo'yidagi yozgi uyimizda katta bazm bilan nishonlashdi. Bu butun oilamiz oylar davomida intiqlik bilan kutgan kun edi va ikki yuzdan ortiq odam keldi.

Tayyorgarlik bir necha kun oldi. Opalarim va men ovqat tayyorlashimiz, uyni tozalashimiz va bezaklarni osishimiz kerak edi. Kechqurun uchun jaz guruhini ham band qilishim kerak edi.

Bazm kechasi hammasi mukammal edi. Mehmonlar bezaklarni tomosha qilib, mazali bufetdan bahra olishdi. Jaz guruhi chala boshlaganda hamma raqsga turdi. Tun bo'yi musiqaga qo'shiq aytib, raqs tushdik.

Bu ajoyib bayram bo'ldi va ota-onam albatta ko'ngil ochishdi. Men charchagan, lekin juda xursand edim. Bu hammamiz uchun ajoyib xotira bo'lishiga ishonaman.

patterns.formula: Last [vaqt] I/we + V2 ... It was a day that we had been looking forward to for ages.
patterns.exampleEn: Last September I graduated from university. It was a day that my friends and I had all been looking forward to for ages.
patterns.exampleUz: O'tgan sentyabrda universitetni bitirdim. Bu do'stlarim va men uzoq vaqtdan beri kutgan kun edi.

patterns.formula: Once X had + V3, Y + V2.
patterns.exampleEn: Once all the students had sat down, the officials came into the hall.
patterns.exampleUz: Barcha talabalar o'tirgach, rahbarlar zalga kirishdi.

patterns.formula: We had to + FE'L, + FE'L and + FE'L. It took several days.
patterns.exampleEn: We had to make the food, clean the house and put up the decorations. It took several days.
patterns.exampleUz: Ovqat tayyorlashimiz, uyni tozalashimiz va bezaklarni osishimiz kerak edi. Bir necha kun oldi.

patterns.formula: Did X enjoy themselves? - Oh yes, they certainly did!
patterns.exampleEn: Did your parents enjoy themselves? - Oh yes, they certainly did!
